doc: Earth windows (STANDARDS sections 8, 10.1). Validation set: 5 classes x (3 dev + 1 reserved) = 20 entries, classes exactly as config/measure.json validation.classes. Replacements of PLAN v2 section 6 applied 2026-11-13. Status approved only after the ESA WorldCover check (60/70/100 share >= 0.8 in the 4 km disk; plains and canyons: share reported, not rejected). Two validation entries stay proposed (Gosses Bluff, Cima) with the reason in notes. Known analogs (role known_analog) are excluded from the search (25 km) and are not part of V2.
center_method: Centre = the feature's coordinate from its Wikipedia article (coordinate template, read from the article HTML geo span or the Wikipedia API prop=coordinates), rounded to 4 decimals. center_source.url is the article. For large fields, seas and plains the centre is the article's coordinate and lies inside the landform; the WorldCover check is the test of that. Earth Impact Database and Global Volcanism Program pages were not usable from this environment (JavaScript redirect).
